posts.title: Model Fingerprinting with Whorl
posts.description: tl;dr LLMs are bad password generators. They generate “random” strings with predictable, model-specific patterns. The password reveals exactly which model produced it, kind of like a shibboleth. whorl exploits this: Like the whorls that make every human fingerprint unique, each model leaves a distinctive pattern in the text it generates.
